messages.text: Will it grow in large pots on a patio?

Yes, several milkweeds can do well in large pots on a patio, as long as you use a big container, lots of sun, and the right soil moisture.

Best choices for pots

Butterfly milkweed (Asclepias tuberosa), best for hot, sunny patios; likes sharp drainage.

Swamp milkweed (Asclepias incarnata), easiest if you can keep the pot consistently moist.

Whorled milkweed (Asclepias verticillata), does well in pots, tolerates drier conditions once established.

Tips for success

Pot size: at least 12–18 in wide, ideally 5–15+ gallons, with drainage holes.

Sun: 6+ hours of direct sun.

Soil: use a high-quality potting mix; add extra perlite/sand for A. tuberosa (avoid staying soggy).

Water: containers dry out fast; swamp milkweed may need frequent watering in summer.

Winter: if you are in a cold-winter area, the roots can freeze in pots; protect the container (move to an unheated garage/shed, or insulate and keep it out of wind).
